- [ ] The guides describe something that now works differently (name the pages if you know them)
- [ ] Upgrading needs a user's action: a Migration note under "Does not compile" or "Compiles, answers differently"
- [ ] A new Cargo feature, for the Feature Flags page
- [ ] The Agent Skill (`skill/volga`) needs the same update
